sup.missions.subtitle: Every mission, built-in and custom. Officers never see this list.
sup.missions.payout_hint.admin: An admin set this mission's payout: permanent until an admin changes it
sup.missions.payout_hint.type: The mission type's payout × its star multiplier
sup.missions.payout_hint.event: The Weekly Boss event payout from the config
sup.missions.launch_message: {mission} becomes the only mission on every department's Mission Board until it is completed or cancelled. Officers from every department can join.
sup.missions.op_locked: Every Mission Board is locked to it until it is completed or cancelled.
sup.missions.eligible_rule: Cross-Department Missions: open to every department, 2+ officers, never the Weekly Boss
sup.live.subtitle: Active runs involving {department}
sup.live.subtitle_all: Every active run on the server
sup.live.empty_text: Runs involving your department appear here while they are active.
sup.live.recall_message: Their {mission} run ends as Abandoned with no cooldown and no penalty. The run continues for anyone left.
sup.live.recall_placeholder: e.g. Needed on a priority call
sup.review.subtitle: Flagged runs and disputes involving your department. Your own runs never appear here.
sup.review.approve_message: {name}'s {mission} run goes back on the leaderboards and their held cash is paid.
sup.review.void_message: {name}'s {mission} run is removed from every leaderboard. Its held cash is not paid once the dispute window closes.
sup.review.dispute_approve_message: {name}'s {mission} run is restored and any held cash is released. Your decision is final.
sup.review.dispute_reject_message: {name}'s {mission} run stays as it is. Your decision is final.
sup.review.empty_flagged_text: Runs the anti-cheat checks flag for your department appear here for review.
sup.review.empty_disputes_text: Disputes officers file about flagged or voided runs appear here.
sup.review.own_rule: Nobody can approve, void or answer a dispute about a run they took part in.
sup.review.no_detail: No extra details were recorded for this flag.
admin.action.free_abandon: Free abandon for a real call
admin.notice.run_approved: A supervisor approved your {mission} run: it counts again.
admin.notice.force_recalled: A supervisor recalled you from your mission. No penalty and no cooldown.
admin.anticheat.idle_notice: You were removed from the run: you did not reach the start in time.
admin.anticheat.presence_detail: Within the presence range for {share}% of the run (needs {need}%)
admin.cmd.usage_reload: /{cmd} reload  reloads built-in and custom mission files
admin.cmd.help_ingame: Subcommands: payout type, payout mission, award, season start, season end, suspend, reload, test, storage, missioncall, check. Run /{cmd} help in the server console for details.
admin.cmd.amount_range: Enter a whole amount from {min} to {max}, or clear.
admin.cmd.test_bad_arg: "{arg}" is not a tier, a location number or random.
admin.cmd.usage_storage: /{cmd} storage  shows where Crimson-Police saves its data (the database or the saves folder), the rows of every table and the size of the saves folder
admin.cmd.usage_storage_copy: /{cmd} storage copy database-to-files|files-to-database [force]  copies every Crimson-Police table between the database and the saves folder
admin.cmd.usage_check: /{cmd} check  runs the start-up check again and lists every line (departments, admins, items, desks and more)
admin.cmd.check_done_ingame: Check: {ok} OK, {warn} warnings, {error} errors. Admin UI → Permissions → Config health lists them.
admin.cmd.storage_usage: Use /{cmd} storage, or /{cmd} storage copy database-to-files|files-to-database [force].
admin.cmd.storage_mode_files: Storage: database off (Config.Database.enabled = false). Everything is saved in the saves folder.
admin.cmd.storage_folder_unused: Saves folder: {path} (not used while Config.Database.enabled = true)
admin.cmd.storage_size_empty: The saves folder holds no Crimson-Police data yet.
admin.cmd.storage_no_database: The database cannot be reached: oxmysql is not running.
admin.cmd.storage_folder_error: The saves folder {path} cannot be used: {error}
admin.cmd.storage_folder_empty: The saves folder {path} holds no Crimson-Police data.
admin.cmd.storage_source_empty: The {source} holds no Crimson-Police tables: nothing to copy.
admin.cmd.storage_target_has_rows: The {target} already has {rows} rows ({tables}). To replace them with the {source}'s data, run /{cmd} storage copy {direction} force
admin.cmd.storage_newer_source: That data was made by a newer Crimson-Police (the migration {file} is not in this resource). Update Crimson-Police first.
admin.cmd.storage_migration_failed: The tables could not be created ({file}): {error}
admin.cmd.storage_missing_table: {table} is in the {source} but not in the {target}. Nothing was copied.
admin.cmd.storage_missing_column: {table}.{column} is in the {source} but not in the {target}. Nothing was copied.
admin.cmd.storage_copy_busy: A storage copy is already running.
admin.cmd.storage_runs_active: Active mission runs: {count}. Copy when every run has ended.
admin.cmd.storage_copy_started: Copying every Crimson-Police table from the {source} to the {target}...
admin.cmd.storage_copy_mismatch: {table}: {rows} rows copied, but the {target} now has {found}.
admin.cmd.storage_copied: Copied {tables} tables and {rows} rows from the {source} to the {target} in {seconds} s. Every id is kept.
admin.cmd.storage_copy_failed: The copy stopped at {table}: {error}. The {target} was emptied again and the {source} is unchanged. Fix the problem and run the copy again.
admin.cmd.storage_next_restart: Restart Crimson-Police now, so every feature loads the copied data.
admin.cmd.storage_next_files: To use the saves folder, set Config.Database.enabled = false in config/config.lua and restart Crimson-Police.
admin.cmd.storage_next_database: To use the database, set Config.Database.enabled = true in config/config.lua and restart Crimson-Police.
admin.officers.subtitle: Search any officer: rank, callsign, history, badges, cash earned, suspensions and disputes
admin.officers.select_text: Search on the left and pick an officer to see their record.
admin.officers.own: This is your own record: you can't answer disputes about runs you took part in.
admin.officers.unknown_row: This officer has not opened the tablet yet: only live data is shown.
admin.officers.stat.flag_hint: {flagged} flagged and {voided} voided runs on record.
admin.officers.suspended_text: They can't open the Officer or Supervisor UI until the suspension ends.
admin.officers.suspend_message: Blocks the officer from Crimson-Police for that many days. It is audited.
admin.officers.unsuspend_message: {name} can use Crimson-Police again at once.
admin.officers.disputes_hint: Failed runs: answer with a manual award or dismiss. Flagged or voided runs: approve or reject. Decisions are final.
admin.officers.award_message: {name} disputed a failed {mission} run. The award is stored as a manual_award row and audited.
admin.officers.dismiss_message: The failed run stays as it is. Your decision is final.
admin.officers.void_message: The {mission} run from {date} is removed from every leaderboard. A paid run is not clawed back.
admin.depts.subtitle: Every department in Config.Departments
admin.depts.subtitle_society: Every department in Config.Departments, with its society balance
admin.depts.cash_source_server: Cash is paid by the server (Config.Cash.source = 'server'), so society balances are not shown.
admin.depts.preview_note: Read-only preview. Colours and logo come from Config.Departments.
admin.depts.preview.card_text: Cards, tables and dialogs use the surface colour; highlights use the accent.
admin.perms.subtitle: A read-only view of Config.Permissions. Admins can always do every action.
admin.perms.edit_hint: Each switch saves at once over config.lua (Admin UI → Settings has every other setting). Admin-only actions always stay admin-only.
admin.perms.admin_only_text: Supervisors never get these, whatever the config says
admin.perms.own_rule: Nobody, admins included, may approve, void or answer a dispute about a run they took part in.
admin.perm_desc.setTypePayout: Change a mission type's payout within Config.Payouts.supervisorRange, once per 30 minutes per type, never a type an admin has set.
admin.perm_desc.launchCrossDept: Launch, start now, relaunch and cancel a Cross-Department Mission.
admin.perm_desc.forceRecall: End an officer's run as Abandoned with no cooldown, for runs involving their department.
admin.perm_desc.reviewFlagged: Approve or void flagged runs involving their department.
admin.perm_desc.handleDisputes: Answer disputes about flagged or voided runs in their department.
admin.perm_desc.builderEdit: Create, edit, record routes for and test their own custom missions.
admin.perm_desc.builderPublish: Publish their own drafts (a passed test is needed only when Config.Builder.requireTestToPublish is on).
admin.perm_desc.builderArchive: Archive or restore their own custom missions.
admin.perm_desc.builderEditAny: Also edit, publish and archive other people's custom missions.
admin.perm_desc.builderRollback: Restore a custom mission's previous version from its backup.
admin.perm_desc.breakEditLock: Unlock a mission someone else is editing.
admin.perm_desc.viewMissionList: See every mission, its payout and who is running it.
admin.perm_desc.setMissionPayout: Set a single mission's permanent payout.
admin.perm_desc.clearPayout: Clear an admin-set type or mission payout.
admin.perm_desc.manualAward: Award points manually, stored as a logged manual_award row.
admin.perm_desc.handleFailedDispute: Answer disputes about failed runs with a manual award or dismiss them.
admin.perm_desc.voidAnyRun: Remove any run from every leaderboard.
admin.perm_desc.seasons: Start or end a season and its department challenge.
admin.perm_desc.bountyOverride: Replace this week's randomly picked bounty.
admin.perm_desc.suspend: Suspend or unsuspend an officer from Crimson-Police.
admin.perm_desc.reloadMissions: Reload built-in and custom mission files without a restart.
admin.perm_desc.testRun: Start any mission at any location and tier; nothing is saved or paid.
admin.audit.subtitle: Every supervisor and admin action, newest first
admin.audit.export_truncated: Only the newest {n} rows were exported. Narrow the filters to export older entries.
admin.audit.copy_failed: The text is selected: press Ctrl+C to copy it.
admin.audit.empty_filtered: No audit entries match these filters
sup.missions.none_text: Check the server console: every mission file that failed to load is listed there.
admin.webhook.dropped: The webhook queue was full: {n} ordinary posts were dropped. Every money and typed-confirmation post was kept. The audit log has every action.
